title: El Palo de Mayo
goal: Be dragged into dancing something you cannot dance
culture: Palo de Mayo comes from the Caribbean coast and is danced everywhere in May. You cannot dance it, which will not save you, and nadie sabe is what everybody says to everybody who tries to get out of it.

beats.es: (Lo agarra de la mano y lo jala hacia la rueda.)
beats.good: True, and it will not save you. Say it anyway — it is the required opening move and she has an answer ready.
Nadie sabe — nobody knows how. It is not true, and it is exactly the right thing to say to somebody who is about to refuse.

beats.en: Like this? Do I move like this?
beats.good: Movete — vos, and no accent on the o. She is your age and dancing with you, so there is no usted anywhere in this.
Ya vas — you are getting it. Vas is the same in vos and tú, which is why it slips past unnoticed. The point is that she said it, and you should believe her.
